The pool is deep (6,629 SOL), so a $20 ticket faces modest impact, and the sell-to-buy ratio is well below 1 in that window. Nothing here shows a factory airdrop dump.

But the case is weak. The class is OPERATOR: one bundle holds 100% of the curve, the top 5 early buyers took 99.9% of the first two minutes (6,506 SOL), and a launch bot was present. Those 153 recent buyers are small against that concentrated base, and an operator with this much supply can exit into any demand. The 6,070x return from the early phase means the price already reflects the operator's entry, not new public demand. Base rates for this structure are roughly break-even at best, before fees of 1.4-5.1%. I would pass.
